title: Native pins: tests for sync, versions, backup and photos
why: Seven ManifestKit rules have no test that pins them, so a Swift change can break sync or restore unseen.
note: Four of seven debts are on main: native-pull-generation-unpinned, native-version-names-unpinned, native-photo-ids-kept-uncalled (PR #205) and native-removal-rule-is-swift (PR #216). Left: native-milestone-needed-unpinned waits on page item 44, native-restore-keeps-old-times waits on page item 43, then native-sync-glue-unpinned. No simulator: swift test --package-path native/ManifestKit proves each.
ask: Lane pins started 2026-11-06 by the coordinator.
